{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Blazer in charcoal grey with a subtle heather texture, tailored single-breasted cut with notch lapels, mid-length hitting just above the hip, wool blend for autumn warmth.
Straight-leg trousers in matching charcoal heather wool, ankle length to balance the silhouette, structured fit at the waist and thigh.
Cotton oxford shirt in soft cream with a pointed collar, classic button-down front, slightly relaxed boxy cut for ease of movement.
Leather loafers in dark taupe brown, slip-on style with minimal hardware, rounded toe for comfort throughout the day.
Gold stud earrings and a slim silver watch to add subtle polish without drawing excessive attention.

This outfit works perfectly for a standard office setting in autumn by providing a neat professional appearance while adhering to her refusal of anything flashy. The monochromatic charcoal base creates a streamlined look that flatters her figure, while the textured fabrics offer necessary warmth and depth appropriate for the season. The inclusion of a blazer ensures she meets business dress code expectations, yet the relaxed shirt cut and slip-on loafers prioritize comfort and freedom of movement for a long workday. Overall, it strikes an ideal balance between fitting the office context and respecting her wish for a restrained, non-glittering aesthetic."}
